title: Create a candid photorealistic vertical
prompt: Create a candid photorealistic vertical smartphone photo of a young Japanese woman, unnamed, resting outside a convenience store during the day. She sits on a low concrete curb at the edge of an asphalt parking lot, framed from head to sneakers with the top of her head near the upper left and her legs filling the lower half. She has shoulder-length slightly messy black hair with wispy bangs, natural makeup, and a quiet downcast expression as she looks at a smartphone held partly out of frame in her left hand. She wears exactly four visible outfit pieces: a pale cream open cardigan, a light blue ribbed camisole, a loose gray knee-length skirt, and white sneakers. Her pose is casual and unguarded, knees apart as she sits, holding exactly one plastic bottled cafe latte in her right hand; the label should read カフェオレ. Beside her on the ground to the lower right are exactly two bags: one beige canvas tote bag and one crinkled white plastic shopping bag. In the background, show a beige convenience-store exterior wall, exactly two metallic utility/trash units, exactly one white standing promotional flag with red Japanese lettering, exactly one blue bicycle-parking sign, painted white parking lines, and rough curb texture. Use natural daylight, soft shadows, realistic skin texture, shallow documentary-style composition, slight handheld smartphone perspective, muted everyday colors, and no glamour posing. The mood should feel like an ordinary fleeting moment of taking a break in front of a convenience store. Avoid studio lighting, fantasy elements, extra people, exaggerated anatomy, or overly polished fashion photography.
